create_dataset_instance: create a StaticThings3D dataset instance with a root path and resolution for stereo view loading
get_dataset_length: get the total number of image pairs available in the StaticThings3D dataset
get_dataset_stats: get a summary string of the number of pairs in the StaticThings3D dataset
load_stereo_views: load a pair of stereo views with images, depthmaps, and camera parameters by index
mask_background_depth: mask background pixels in depthmaps by setting values greater than 200 to zero
